label: assemble-help
stdout:
usage: assemble.py [-h] [--reports DIR_OR_GLOB [DIR_OR_GLOB ...]]
                   [--carry PATH] [--repo REPO] [--out OUT]
                   [--expect-skill-sha SHA] [--selftest]

Assemble the tameshi round-18 cold-read ledger (v2) from seat reports.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --reports DIR_OR_GLOB [DIR_OR_GLOB ...]
                        report directories (globbed for *.md), report files,
                        or glob patterns
  --carry PATH          carry entries from a prior ledger, retaining their
                        original evidence and adding carried_from
  --repo REPO           lane git repo used to resolve pages at read_rev
                        (default: the lane containing this script)
  --out OUT             ledger output path (default: ledger.json next to this
                        script)
  --expect-skill-sha SHA
                        sha256 of the page whose every bucket must be covered
                        (default: require coverage of every observed page)
  --selftest            run built-in synthetic self-test and exit
